pages.text: A grand $(thing)white castle$() stands abandoned in the thorny highlands of the Twilight Forest. The champion of flame awaits a worthy foe, and all have fallen short of his expectations.$(br2)$(item)Ignited Revenants$() guard the central keep from intruders, and when slain, they leave behind pale ashes.

These ashes, when sprinkled atop the Withered Nether Star, will be enough to get the attention of $(item)Ignis$().$(br2)In the very likely outcome that you die in battle, Ignis will return the star and ashes to you. $(thing)Good luck$().

The greatest defense Ignis has is his impenetrable $(item)shield$(). None of your attacks will pierce it, so you'll need to either fight around it or $(item)deflect$() a particular purple projectile back at Ignis.$(br2)Additionally, if you're ever $(thing)punched$() by Ignis, you'll be stunned, so pay attention and $(thing)block$() when he's winding up!$(br2)

If you win, you'll be rewarded with $(item)Ignitium Ingots$(). These ingots are used to create incredible armor with extra fire-related abilities, and after you've created a $(item)Mechanical Fusion Anvil$(), they can upgrade an Empowered Command Block Sword or Pickaxe!
